dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibiting a slight concave curvature from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute triangular apex with a small-radius rounded morphology.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour measured at approximately 60 degrees relative to the visible dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Blunt, highly convex melon with a large arc radius forming a rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum with minimal horizontal extension relative to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse interior angle of approximately 160 degrees at the transition point between the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark pigmentation zone surrounding the eye and extending along the line of the mouth.
